title: Verwijzing naar de data van: Crime within relations - Notifications of crime within relations
descriptions: The project investigates the characteristics and backgrounds of crime within relations, its prevalence, type of perpetrators and characteristics of victims. Effects of various types of interventions and sanctions are explored. Studying which types of crime within relations are discovered by the police, its backgrounds and characteristics, interventions and sanctions.
Data available in consultation with NSCR. Please contact the datamanager [datamanagement@nscr.nl]

spatial_coverage: Police districts of Haaglanden and Hollands Midden
data_sources: All notification of battery and stalking in 2 police districts between 02-2001 en 04-2001 (N=293). Analysis of notifications with help of a checklist: reports of interrogations, as well as court decisions if present.
